<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a dominant M peak at 127.10, an M+1 peak at ~8 % intensity, and rapidly diminishing higher‑mass peaks spaced by ~1 Da—the only element whose natural isotopic distribution matches this pattern is carbon (^13C ≈ 1.1 % per carbon). No characteristic Cl, Br, or S patterns are present, and other elements have much lower natural abundances that would not produce the observed peaks. Therefore, carbon can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
